summary: Nora can copy a file somebody shared a link to onto her computer, to compute on it there.
details: computer_import now also takes a shared file's link handle code or its link: the file is fetched fresh from the source and written into her computer's inbox/, a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck as docx, xlsx or pptx.
The copy is a snapshot: its answer gives the file's last-modified time, and a later copy fetches again. Nothing is cached in Nora.
Her Google sign-in never enters the computer; only the file's bytes do. The fetch runs before the computer is locked, so a slow provider never makes the room's computer busy.
A code that names both a sent file and a shared link is answered as ambiguous, never guessed.
The Drive file id is stripped from the request URLs Nora logs.
limitations: Inert until [external_files] and [computer] are both on (S5).
The routing case for the copy is written and not yet run.
